title: A big-endian header and its checksum
hints: The checksum sums 16-bit words with the first byte as the high byte. After every addition, fold any carry above bit 15 back into the low 16 bits; the result is the NOT of the final sum.
Verifying works because a packet that contains its own correct checksum sums to `0xFFFF`, so its "checksum" computed again is `0`.
